subject: MAP: Redwood + Globex — Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa)
thread_summary: Post-call MAP follow-up capturing vendor onboarding milestones for Globex (Coupa setup, W-9, ACH banking details). Redwood to complete vendor paperwork and SOC2 evidence; Globex to create vendor record and issue vendor code. Target close: 2026-08-05.

Subject: MAP: Redwood + Globex — Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa)

Hi Sophie / Alan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I’m sending a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the vendor onboarding milestone we need to close procurement and get Redwood into Globex’s systems. Key asks and proposed timeline below. Please confirm or update.

High-level MAP milestone for vendor onboarding (proposed):
- Redwood: Provide completed vendor forms (W-9, Coupa supplier request, ACH/banking info) — target Jul 20, 2026
- Globex Procurement: Submit supplier request in Coupa and issue vendor code — target Jul 28, 2026
- Globex Finance: Approve payment terms / banking details — target Aug 2, 2026
- Go-live / first billable traffic: target Aug 5, 2026

Dependencies / notes:
- Globex prefers Coupa (you mentioned Ariba is also used by some business units). Please confirm which portal we should use and whether you will send an invite or we should submit a supplier request link.
- Procurement needs W-9 and ACH form (banking) — I’ll attach our W-9 and start the DocuSign envelope for the vendor form today.
- If you need any legal redlines on the SOW or T&Cs, loop in the legal contact and let us know; we’ll aim to keep procurement timeline intact.

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Globex_Draft.pdf (MAP draft with milestone table + responsibilities).

Next steps I’ll take today: send completed W-9 and start the DocuSign vendor packet; Marissa (cc) will support Finance/billing questions.

Can you confirm the preferred portal (Coupa vs Ariba) and the procurement contact who will create the vendor record? Also confirm whether your team needs any additional evidence (e.g., SOC2 report) for onboarding.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
